_readme: Claude appends an entry here whenever deck data or app behavior changes (newest first). Shown verbose in the settings footer, but ONLY for the JST account. Keep summaries short; details are 1-line bullets.

entries.summary: Learn New now opens only genuinely unseen cards
details: Set counts now use the same cross-artist, cross-mode, and Merge Lemmas progress rules as final deck construction, so the advertised new-card count matches the cards that open
If progress finishes the advertised cards before the tap completes, Learn New reports that the set is complete and refreshes setup instead of silently opening the full set as Study Again

entries.summary: Artist decks now build from versioned lyric evidence
details: Spanish Test Playlist now has a stable ledger of 980 lyric segments and 6,897 exact token occurrences; the shipped deck was rebuilt from its active evidence profile and added to the offline catalogue

A conservative, replaceable vocal-artifact layer recorded 832 adlib/stutter claims; strict neutral parity stayed exact, and the basic policy currently changes no vocabulary because the legacy tokenizer already ignored those occurrences
The exact local SpanishDict menu and assignment inputs were frozen as hashed immutable snapshots, with all 2,170 assignment records linked to stable occurrences

entries.summary: Spotify playback now works for mixed-artist playlist cards
details: Playlist examples retain the exact Spotify track ID and the song's real artist from the playlist source, so the play button no longer tries to look up the playlist name as though it were an artist
Spanish Test Playlist rebuilt with 2,042 linked lyric examples across its 17 source tracks; non-lyric support examples stay non-playable by design

entries.summary: Shared Spanish word identity and merged-lemma learning now carry across Lyrics and Speech
details: Normal Spanish now reuses the active artist ID for every shared surface-and-lemma pair, including the rare six-character hash-collision cases; legacy normal IDs migrate directly to their final shared ID

Learn New checks the other mode as well as the current deck, and Merge Lemmas also excludes a lemma already seen through a different artist or Speech form — so a known tocar no longer returns as a new playlist card

entries.summary: Lyrics mode was reverting the POS pill's position
details: body.artist-mode set position: relative on every direct child of the card face to lift them above the album-artwork overlay. That silently reverted any child positioning itself absolutely — the POS pill left the top-right corner and fell back into flow at the bottom of the card, in lyrics mode only, which is why the corner fix appeared to work in Speech and not in Lyrics
Children that own their positioning (POS pills, ranking, tint, exit button) are excluded from that rule and get their stacking layer stated directly instead
The ranking line had already been patched individually for the same cause; the general fix covers the rest

entries.summary: Repair two dead references left by the lazy-module split, and stop a failed search card from stranding the deck
details: updateCard() called getVocabByIdLookup() and goBackToSetup() cleared two lookup caches that only existed inside the lazily loaded modal module — both threw ReferenceError; the caches now live in shared state and the lookup is owned by the core file
Homograph 'also:' chips were the visible casualty of the first one; no current Spanish or artist deck ships homograph ids, so it had been latent since April
If a search result fails to render, the temporary card and nav-stack entry are now rolled back to the card you were on instead of leaving the deck pointed at a card that never drew
The find-word sheet now names the actual failure instead of a bare 'Could not open card' — the reason is readable on a phone with no console
Child cards from search or synonyms lost the floating X: the way out is now a 'Back to <word>' control filling the top bar, which names the card it returns to instead of leaving you to infer it
That top bar stays on child cards (it used to fade out entirely); the pip row and card chevrons hide instead, since neither addresses a card in the active set from there
Top bar reclaimed its outer inset and trimmed its gaps, so the chevrons, pips and gear all grew into the row's fixed height
POS pills sit in the same top-right corner on every card — child cards no longer push them down 62px to clear an exit disc that is gone
The x/y known tile is hidden on single-meaning cards, where it only restated the whole-card answer

The English→Spanish front was the one face that put its POS pill inside the meaning row, halfway down the card, and force-hid the corner element — that was the pill that kept reappearing at the bottom; both directions now render into the same top-right corner, verified by measuring it at 30px from top and right
Verb conjugation panel now covers the whole screen: it is re-parented to the body while open, because inside the card it was clipped by the face and positioned against the card's 3D flip transform
Conjugation colours moved into the VERB green — moods are hue steps within that family instead of blue/purple/pink, and the endings no longer take the app's orange-red accent
The row holding the card's own form is now a filled green block with a 4px rail, not a 14%-alpha tint that read as striping; close button is a 48px disc instead of a 22px glyph
Gerund and past participle dropped out of the header into a quiet strip below the paradigm; table rows grew into the height a full screen provides

entries.summary: Card typography, morphology rows, a playing animation, and a top-entering leave dialog
details: Italic sub-senses are no longer shaved on the right — italic glyphs lean past their advance width, and every clip box was sized from that width; the fix adds a sliver of trailing space on the italic spans themselves
Headword is bigger on both faces (64→70px front, 42→48 back), with a measured step-down so a long word shrinks only as far as the POS pill actually demands
Card back's top control row lost its divider line and most of its padding; chevrons, pips and gear all grew into the reclaimed space

Morphology popover now shows one row per complete reading — Spanish subject chip paired with the tense it belongs to — instead of loose pills that left person and tense unlinked; extra readings sit behind a + control
Spotify button ripples outward while audio is actually playing, driven by real playback state, and clears on pause, track end and snippet stop
Child cards from search or synonyms get a full 44px exit button instead of a 28px ghost; POS pills step down on those cards so the two don't overlap
The leaving-Fluency confirmation now drops in from the top like the other sheets, and animates back out the same way
Card flagging: any successful flag now closes the sheet, and a failure shows the actual error instead of a generic message

entries.summary: See Example: rewritten for someone who has never used the app, and less chrome
details: Every title, summary and note rewritten in plain English — no "pipeline", "corpus", "sense" or "deck"; a stranger reading it should follow how the app works
Lyrics/Speech tabs moved to the header's left edge; the "See Example" banner is gone — it only told you what you had just clicked
The ✕ exits the whole detour to the app rather than dropping you back on the About page you passed through
Dropped the "Bad Bunny · front of card" line: the tab says which deck, the card says which side
Cut the "disambiguating context" note and tightened the rest
Annotations are now even on both sides of the card — 5/5 on the Lyrics back, 3/3 on Speech
Cache v207→v208 / assets 20260805n→o

entries.summary: Card-surface polish pass: long-press popovers, Spotify loading ring, settings split into Deck vs Learning
details: Settings → Study is now two labelled groups: Deck Settings (what ends up in the deck) and Learning Settings (how cards are presented)
Every setting has a ? that reveals a one-line explanation; cognate sensitivity is hidden entirely unless cognates are excluded
Study-options radial icons and labels are noticeably bigger
Long-press the headword: a small popover explains the direction switch, tap the pill to flip, tap away to cancel — replaces the old bare inline button
Long-press the Spotify button for the same style of popover with an autoplay toggle; the preference persists
Spotify button shows a rotating ring while the track is starting, cleared by the real playback-start signal (with timeouts so it can't spin forever)
Long artist and song names now ellipsize instead of breaking the credit line
Fixed: the Spotify logo painted over the synonyms panel — an inline z-index:999 outranked the card-face overlays
Synonyms that have no card now ask for confirmation before leaving the app for SpanishDict
Synonym icon redrawn as a proper stroked vector so it matches the Known / Look up tiles
The X/N known-senses sheet now drops in from the top instead of rising from the bottom
Past-participle POS pill: not done — the deck JSON carries no participle signal, only plain ADJ, so it needs a pipeline change first

entries.summary: About gains "See Example" — a real card, annotated on both sides, with working Spotify
details: Opens on the BACK of the card: senses, shares and lyric evidence all visible at once, which is what the app is actually for
Annotations belong to the face, not the tab — flipping the card swaps the whole numbered set, so labels never linger over the side that turned away
Notes run down both sides of a centred card; each badge pins to the edge nearest its own note instead of crossing the card
The tab now only switches deck (Lyrics / Speech); face is chosen by flipping, as everywhere else in the app
The card is the real one: same classes, same inline styles, and the back-face layout rules are now shared with #backContent rather than copied, so the replica can't drift
The Spotify button is live — real track ids and lyric timestamps, routed through spotifyPlayTrack(), login hand-off included
Nothing writes progress or touches deck state, so it runs for logged-out visitors on ?about=1

entries.summary: Unified every cache-busting tag so edits stop arriving late or not at all
details: 19 module-to-module imports had drifted two days behind main.js, leaving three separate copies of state.js loaded at once — the module cache keys by URL, so a stale tag is a second module, not a second reference
Every ?v= is now rewritten by pattern rather than by replacing the previous value, which is the mechanism that let the drift build up unnoticed
tools/check_asset_versions.py fails on any disagreement, so this cannot quietly return

entries.summary: Bottom link row is bare icons at a readable size; POS pills own the top-right corner
details: Conjugate, Synonyms and the knowledge map lose the white plate behind their glyphs — every tile is now just an icon and a label, matching Look up; labels go 12px→13.5px
The gap between the example box and the link row drops from 15px to 6px
POS pills are 10% larger and stay in the top-right corner even when a word has two or three parts of speech; the chooser hint sits in the gap directly above them and reads just "Choose"

The set scrubber no longer jumps to the end of the set and back when phrases open — it holds the word's own position and that number turns violet for as long as you're in phrases; phrase cards also open straight onto the back instead of showing a front that only repeated the word you just answered

Merge Lemmas silently did nothing on any route that skipped the setup panel (Continue set, direct deck start) — the card kept its surface form and the front listed every recorded spelling of the word. The front now also filters and caps that list the way the back always did

Bottom link row is a fixed order — known, synonyms, conjugate — with Look up pinned to the right edge instead of sliding with the tile count; Look up now pops the SpanishDict/Reverso icons up as circles above it rather than opening a text dropdown
The front POS pill moves to the card's top-right corner, matching the back, and verb morphology is hidden until you press the pill
Continue set is now per-deck: opening Bad Bunny offers your Bad Bunny set instead of resuming a Speech set and redirecting you there. The landing still offers whatever you studied last

Verb morphology no longer takes up space on the card: pressing the verb POS pill opens a small popover under it listing the possible forms, on both faces. The old in-place strip, its "+" expander and the hidden toggle on re-pressing an active POS tab are gone

Front of card: the lyric-line count, spoken frequency and vocabulary rank are bold white, while the wording and the "/ total vocabulary" denominator stay muted; the POS pill sits in the top-right corner as intended
Bottom link icons are 50% larger again

Synonyms opens as a full-card panel with Synonyms/Antonyms tabs and a larger close button. Every entry now carries the same tappable styling and a chevron — previously in-deck words got an accent outline that read as "special" and everything else was dimmed to look disabled

Fixed the reason CSS changes kept not appearing: css/style.css was the only boot asset with no ?v= cache-buster, and the service worker's precache could satisfy the unchanged URL straight from the browser's disk cache. New JS was running against an old stylesheet — which is why the POS pill stayed at the bottom of the card and the link icons appeared to change size at random. The stylesheet is now versioned like every module, and install force-refreshes every precached file

entries.summary: Card-back controls are simpler: fewer buttons, morphology on demand, footer pinned in place
details: The lemma sits left-aligned under the headword at a slightly smaller size; the Spotify button doubles as the lyric-autoplay toggle on a long press, replacing the separate autoplay icon

Verb morphology is now formatted like the POS pills and stays hidden until you press the pill, instead of always showing; POS pills are bigger, vertically centred with the word, and the multi-POS chooser can sit inline to the right instead of forcing a new line

The flag icon and the old POS-info popup merge into one flag button that opens a small choice sheet, same pattern as Look up; the bottom row of icon links is now pinned to the card's bottom edge instead of drifting with example length; cache v183→v184 / assets 20260803e→20260804a

entries.summary: Card back is more legible on small phones, and Expressions/clitics now hand off as follow-up cards
details: Nothing on the back reads below 14px anymore; sense rows use flat fills with a check glyph plus bold text for the selected sense instead of relying on color alone, and the example box and reference-link icons grow to real touch targets

Expressions and pronominal forms leave the pinned tray: a small "N phrases next" row tells you what's coming, and marking the word correct opens each one as its own mini card (progress dots, breadcrumb back to the word, Next: preview) before returning you to the deck

Each phrase card is its own title-page layout (badge, expression, translation, example) instead of a squeezed sense row, the selected sense on the parent card shows a checkmark instead of relying on colour alone, and finishing or skipping the phrase queue continues straight to the next real card instead of bouncing back through the parent
Grades on those follow-up cards write to the same per-Expression/clitic knowledge store the old tray rows used, so tracking is unchanged; cache v180→v183 / assets 20260803b→20260803e

entries.summary: Spanish Speech vNext is now a reversible candidate method in the real app
details: The new index.html?speech=vnext route uses the existing Fluency flashcard UI to show important SpanishDict senses, broad prominence labels and exact SpanishDict examples

Its first four-word deck is an immutable versioned run with a checksum manifest, legacy whole-word IDs, stable SpanishDict sense IDs and every non-displayed dictionary sense retained for later migration

The ordinary Speech route and active legacy deck remain unchanged; unaudited corpus matches and legacy percentages are not imported as vNext truth, pilot answers cannot alter progress, and cache v179→v180 / assets 20260803a→20260803b

entries.summary: Card grammar, Expressions, and set completion now read more clearly
details: The back uses one occupied grammar block: a distinct lemma shares its identity row with POS, repeated lemmas leave no hole, and verb morphology wraps on its own row
Expression rows now stack the source phrase above its English meaning with a subtle divider instead of mixing both languages inline

Set completion removes mistake-only review and duplicate no-mistakes copy, keeps compact icon actions for Main menu and Redo set, and lets desktop Enter start the suggested next set; cache v178→v179, assets 20260802i→20260803a

entries.summary: Example lyrics no longer waste a line on ad-libs
details: Parenthetical ad-libs like (Eh-eh), (Wuh) and (Yeah) are hidden in the example area — they appear on 27% of lines and cost about a fifth of the visible text
Only short ones go: two words and ten characters at most, which removes 2647 of them across the Bad Bunny deck without touching a single real sung line
The lyric itself is unchanged in the data, so nothing else is affected; cache v177→v178, assets 20260802h→20260802i

entries.summary: Personalised Spanish practice now has a reviewed scale pilot
details: Expanded the offline personalised bank from 15 to 27 examples while preserving the exact target sense and selecting examples only for words missed in the last seven days
The pilot proposed 58 variants: structural checks retained 23, the semantic gate retained 16, and explicit review retained 12 after catching four confidently approved but unsuitable sentences
Generated examples remain separate from sense-frequency estimates and require no model call during study; cache v176→v177, assets 20260802g→20260802h

entries.summary: Card tools are sharper and information popups scroll reliably
details: Replaced the enlarged SpanishDict and Reverso favicon artwork with density-independent vector marks so both remain crisp
Synonyms and Verb now share the translucent white tile treatment used by the sense-progress control
POS information now scrolls inside a height-limited touch surface and closes only from its close button, backdrop or Escape; cache v175→v176, assets 20260802f→20260802g

entries.summary: Spanish Speech now starts from exact SpanishDict examples
details: Replaced subtitle examples with 27,115 SpanishDict examples tied directly to 25,978 displayed sense IDs while retaining the previous sense percentages as an explicit provisional proxy
Repaired 261 source records whose Spanish and English sides were reversed; the new deck is about 8.2 MB instead of 32 MB and remains an immutable, reversible candidate run

Added a first offline personalisation beta: 15 independently audited templates appear only when their reinforcement word was answered incorrectly in the last seven days; no live model call and no generated sentence affects percentages; cache v174→v175, assets 20260802e→20260802f

entries.summary: Short italic submeanings now grow with their sense rows
details: Italic context and submeaning text now uses the same content-aware size tiers as the main translation instead of staying uniformly small
The shortest rows can show italic supporting text at 17px, with progressively denser rows stepping through 15px, 13px and 11.5px
Long context remains compact enough to preserve wrapping and card layout; cache v173→v174, assets 20260802d→20260802e

entries.summary: The main menu now advances to the first genuinely unseen set
details: Levels whose available cards have all been seen no longer trap setup on their final set just because some cards remain in the separate Review queue
Opening the app and returning from study now bypass fully seen or suggestion-skipped levels, while an explicit manual level choice still remains available
Cached progress is applied before the first automatic choice and refreshed progress can correct an automatic choice; cache v172→v173, assets 20260802c→20260802d

entries.summary: Expression translations now stay white
details: English text in Expression/MWE and clitic rows is explicitly white and remains italic
The row-specific colour now wins over the later generic strong-text accent rule, preventing artist themes from turning translations red
Added a regression assertion for the CSS cascade; cache v171→v172, assets 20260802b→20260802c

entries.summary: Card rows now use clearer colour identities and make better use of space
details: Proper nouns, auxiliaries, conjunction types, particles, prefixes, suffixes, contractions, expressions and clitics now have explicit colour themes instead of falling back to another category
Expression rows prefer one compact line with upright Spanish, italic English and quieter context, wrapping only when the content needs it
Short sense and expression text grows to use available room while progressively longer copy steps down before wrapping or clamping; cache v170→v171, assets 20260802a→20260802b

entries.summary: App startup and study interactions now do substantially less background work
details: Cached deck files no longer re-download in the background on every visit, and retained downloads use one direct manifest-indexed cache lookup instead of scanning every installed source per request
Progress snapshots are batched during idle time while each answer remains immediately durable in the offline sync queue; repeated setup filtering and unchanged card DOM/layout work are reused

Normal Speech startup no longer evaluates Spotify or large card-modal code, full conjugation tables load only when opened, and artist offline-download metadata is valid again; cache v169→v170, assets 20260801b→20260802a

entries.summary: Morphology pills now read like Spanish conjugation labels
details: Replaced technical person-and-number wording with Yo, Tú, Él(la), Nosotros, Vosotros and Ellos
Ambiguous forms retain every applicable subject in one pill, such as Yo/Él(la)
Present is now implicit when it is the only tense, but remains visible when another tense must be distinguished; cache v168→v169, assets 20260801a→20260801b

entries.summary: Study preferences and morphology alternatives are more focused
details: Study preferences opened from an active deck now shows only Study, while main-menu Settings still exposes the full tab set
Removed obsolete artist-category hide controls from Study and restored a tappable explanation for cognate sensitivity
Morphology shows one preferred analysis by default, prioritizes indicative over imperative, and expands complete coupled alternatives from + pills; cache v167→v168, assets 20260731m→20260801a

entries.summary: Rosalía and Young Miko rebuilt with the same fixes as Bad Bunny
details: Both decks now merge the extra Caribbean elisions, carry register tags (slang, vulgar, regional, loanword) and use the corrected lemma layer
manín finally reads bro, buddy (slang) instead of being filed under maní (peanut) — the flag that started this thread
Added 734 dictionary entries and ran a Gemini pass over 490 newly classifiable words plus gap-fill; master grew to 17174 entries with 744 new senses

entries.summary: Settings now separates study, offline tools, and app-data auditing
details: Study preferences from the card opens the Study tab directly, while the sync-status pill opens Offline & sync
The former Data tab is now Offline & sync; deployment freshness, app version, and recent changes have their own JST-only App data tab
Removed the premature Artists settings tab and recorded a future combined multi-artist and per-album selector in the app backlog; cache v166→v167, assets 20260731l→20260731m

entries.summary: Newly merged words got real meanings from a Gemini pass
details: Words that only appeared after the elision fixes (crecidos, jodidos, patadas, calladitas, paraos) had blank cards; they now carry proper senses — 85 fewer empty cards
Ran on gemini-3.5-flash-lite for 93 cards plus gap-fill, after fetching 598 missing dictionary entries and rebuilding the sense menu from 8310 to 8710 words
Register tags now sit at 1797 across the deck; the remaining blank cards are almost all single-occurrence words that are excluded from sense assignment by design

entries.summary: Kept card headwords white
details: Front and back headwords now remain white whether or not the displayed word is already the lemma
POS colour is reserved for a separately displayed citation lemma and still updates with the selected POS

entries.summary: Separated word and lemma colour hierarchy
details: A surface word stays white when a separate citation lemma is shown; when the displayed word is itself the lemma, it receives the active POS colour
Lemma colour follows POS selection on both card faces and automatically mixes toward the theme text colour for stronger contrast

entries.summary: Improved card hierarchy and multi-POS defaults
details: The active-set scrubber gives the large central numbers more breathing room while the smaller distant markers cluster progressively toward the ends
Example text is upright and only its translation remains italic; multi-POS cards start with the POS carrying the greatest summed sense frequency and show common POS choices first
The POS chooser no longer has an enclosing panel, and front/back headwords and lemmas now follow the active POS colour and update when the POS changes

entries.summary: Cleaned up study controls and morphology labels
details: The active-set connector is neutral grey and no longer shows through subdued card-number markers; the icon-only Study options target reaches the top edge on mobile
Study options use cleaner icon-and-text targets, explicitly say how to close the radial, and no longer include Shuffle
Morphology omits assumed indicative and affirmative labels, combines person and number, and uses compact SING and PLURAL wording

entries.summary: Rebuilt Bad Bunny: ad-libs removed, elisions merged, lemmas corrected
details: Rap ad-libs where a word tail is echoed (entera-tera, perrear -rrear, alcohol-cohol) no longer become cards; words like over that are echoed once but real elsewhere keep their card and lose only that line
More Caribbean elisions now merge into their real word: to s and to as into todos/todas (180 occurrences), metio into metidos, vengamo into vengamos — 58 fewer half-merged forms
manin is no longer filed under mani (peanut) and selfie no longer under the invented selfi; josear now reads to hustle rather than the name Joseph

entries.summary: Bigger study controls and clearer morphology alternatives
details: The active-set number scrubber and Study options button are larger, with a taller mobile rail and easier touch targets
The scrubber connector now sits on its own layer behind opaque markers, so it no longer shows through the numbered shapes
Morphology uses a slash only for ambiguous person such as 1st/3rd; different number, tense, or mood analyses render as separate pill rows; cache v161→v162, assets 20260731g→20260731h

entries.summary: Cards now show how a word is used — slang, vulgar, regional
details: Sense rows carry a small register tag where the pipeline has one: 1602 meanings across 1310 Bad Bunny cards, mostly slang (946), figurative (372), regional (127), loanword (104) and vulgar (52)

These tags were already being produced for every deck build and then discarded twice over — once at pipeline assembly and again when the front end rebuilt meanings — so nothing new had to be generated to surface them
Vulgar gets a warning tint; other and proper_noun stay hidden since neither tells a learner anything the card does not already show; cache v160→v161, assets 20260731f→20260731g

entries.summary: Reconnect sync now tolerates iPhone network warm-up
details: The queue waits 1.5 seconds after iOS reports online before its first upload attempt
Transient failures retry automatically with bounded exponential backoff and show Changes pending until all automatic attempts are exhausted
App launch and foregrounding resume previously failed transient operations; explicit Sync now still retries immediately

entries.summary: Fixed the startup parser error blocking the entire app
details: Corrected a malformed URL-sanitizing regular expression in the new sync queue that browsers rejected before main.js could run
This was the root cause of the spinner, static login, and nonfunctional setup after fallback login
Added a regression assertion for the browser-safe regex literal and retained the earlier fail-open login safeguards

entries.summary: Login has a Safari-safe non-module fallback
details: Continue with initials, guest mode, Continue, and Back now have direct inline handlers that work even if Safari aborts the module graph
The mobile login returns to the center of the screen and its controls explicitly accept touch input above surrounding layers
The full module handlers still take over normally when app initialization succeeds

entries.summary: Login controls remain usable during a stalled boot
details: Authentication click handlers now attach before artist or configuration loading begins, rather than after those requests finish
Opening login forcibly removes the boot overlay and places authentication above every transient app overlay
The static fallback login can no longer be revealed by the watchdog without its controls being initialized

entries.summary: Home Screen startup no longer waits on offline services
details: Login and guest controls become interactive before remote secrets, IndexedDB, or the offline-content catalogue initialize
Safari-sensitive storage and catalogue requests now time out safely, while sync and download setup continue in the background
An offline launch without the remote endpoint uses durable local progress immediately and reconciles when connectivity returns

entries.summary: Offline downloads and durable progress sync
details: The app shell now installs independently from optional decks, retained Spanish/French/artist content can be downloaded or removed in Settings, and verified downloads survive app restarts

Progress, sense answers, flags, and notes enter an IndexedDB queue immediately with stable idempotency keys, bounded retry, authentication pause, foreground/reconnect triggers, and explicit Sync now controls
The status pill and Data settings distinguish connectivity, synchronization, pending/failed work, app updates, and device-local content; ambiguous server responses remain queued

entries.summary: Rebuilt Bad Bunny with Gemini's sense tags finally reaching the deck
details: 1779 register tags now survive into the vocabulary (slang 944, figurative 372, other 174, regional 127, loanword 104, vulgar 52, proper_noun 4) — they were being computed and then discarded at assembly

Proper nouns are recognised by their tag rather than by a regex on the gloss text, so names with a real description (Beatles, Wisin, Miguel, PR, Nio Garcia) are now correctly tagged instead of sitting in the main deck with an empty meaning
Fixed two bad lemmas that a stale build had kept (fulete no longer filete, hermas no longer horma) and collapsed duplicate senses left by the older PROPER_NOUN spelling

entries.summary: Study options now matches the scrubber tile shape
details: Changed the Study options control from a 44px circle to the same softly rounded 36×36px, 10px-radius tile used by scrubber positions
Increased the gear from 22px to 26px and reduced internal padding from 10px to 5px so the icon uses substantially more of the available shape; cache v152→v153, assets 20260729x→20260729y

entries.summary: Scrubber results are clearer and morphology exactly matches POS pills
details: Replaced circular markers with softly rounded 36×36px tiles so one- and two-digit positions use the shape more naturally, and switched their numbers to the normal reading/interface font
Unanswered cards remain neutral, correct-only cards are green, incorrect-only cards are red, and cards answered both ways are amber; the current card keeps its separate accent outline and lens scale
Result state is also included in each marker's accessible label and data attribute

Morphology now reuses the actual POS-pill classes on each card face, matching its connected Verb pill's font, size, weight, casing, padding, radius, fill, border, and colour rather than approximating them; cache v151→v152, assets 20260729w→20260729x

entries.summary: The mobile numbered rail is now a real drag scrubber
details: On mobile, pressing and dragging horizontally across the connected card rail now moves continuously through the active set at roughly one card per 24px, with bounds at the first and last card
Intermediate scrubbed cards do not trigger speech, the active marker follows immediately without queued smooth scrolling, and release suppresses the synthetic click that could otherwise jump twice

Ordinary number taps remain available; active mobile drag brightens the rail and accelerates marker transitions, while desktop drag behavior remains unchanged; cache v150→v151, assets 20260729v→20260729w

entries.summary: The card-position control now reads as a connected animated scrubber
details: Added a continuous accent-tinted rail through the numbered markers and reduced their spacing so they read as one scrub control rather than unrelated buttons
The active marker now travels with a 300ms lens-like expand-and-settle animation while neighbouring markers progressively ease in size and opacity
Increased marker diameter to 36px and number text to bold 16px so each number uses the available shape instead of floating undersized inside it; cache v149→v150, assets 20260729u→20260729v

entries.summary: Audit flags now record every field in its own sheet column
details: FlaggedWords moves to schema v2: 24 real columns (Target, Category, Lemma, CardId, SenseId, SenseGloss, Example, Song, ExampleAssignment, TranslationSource, Note) instead of one free-text blob, so audits can be sorted and filtered
Both flag entry paths (audit menu and quick actions) now emit one canonical set of stable target/category keys rather than two different sets of display labels
Migrated all 29 existing flags with zero parse failures, copied the old tab to FlaggedWords_v1_backup, and dropped three blank legacy rows; cache v153→v154, assets 20260729y→20260729z

entries.summary: Desktop scrubber and Study options now occupy a real row above the card
details: Changed the desktop card container to a vertical layout with the card-position scrubber and icon-only Study options button in a dedicated 44px control row before the card
Removed the desktop absolute overlay positioning while preserving the centred scrubber, right-side settings icon, stacked-card hiding, and existing mobile top-rail layout
The card retains its existing desktop height and now begins beneath an explicit 8px control-row gap; cache v148→v149, assets 20260729t→20260729u

entries.summary: Morphology now uses full names and matches the POS pill
details: Replaced abbreviated codes such as 1/3SG, PRES, and SUBJ with readable labels such as 1st/3rd singular, present, and subjunctive while preserving category-specific ambiguity
Morphology items now match POS pills more closely through the same reading font, 11px size, 600 weight, 4×8px padding, fully rounded shape, tinted fill, and proportional border
